summary: The library chart lands its outcome: eight helpers copied verbatim under the homelab-shared.* prefix (diffed against the HelmCharts source), the PreSync hook Job matching design.md:331-357 field for field, the quoted R5 pin reaching a consumer through the coalesced values key, and HelmCharts untouched. No gate was recorded, so I ran it — lint and test green from the repo root — and probed it rather than trusting it: the pin assertion and the prefix negative test both bite under mutation, and the one unguarded value (the image tag) fails loudly rather than silently when coalescing is broken. Two Minor advisory findings only: unignored helm-dependency artifacts under tests/consumer/, and ceph PVC coverage limited to the legacy inline-PV branch.
